business.name: Pet Center Foundation
business.tagline: Connecting loving families with animals in need
business.address: 235-269 N Beverly Dr, Beverly Hills, CA
business.description: A nonprofit pet adoption center serving Beverly Hills and the greater LA area. Every adoption changes two lives — the pet's, and yours.

qanda.question: Do you require an appointment to visit and meet the animals?
qanda.answer: Walk-ins are welcome during open hours, but we recommend calling ahead if you want to meet a specific animal, since some may be off-site for vet visits.

qanda.question: Is there an adoption fee, and what does it cover?
qanda.answer: Yes, fees range from $75-$250 depending on the animal, and cover spay/neuter, vaccinations, microchipping, and an initial vet checkup.

qanda.question: Can I foster before committing to a full adoption?
qanda.answer: We do offer foster-to-adopt for select animals — ask our adoption coordinators during your visit and they can walk you through it.

testimonials.name: Jennifer M.
testimonials.text: Adopting through PetCenter was the best decision we made. The process was smooth, staff was incredibly helpful, and our rescue dog settled in perfectly. Highly recommend to anyone looking to give a pet a loving home.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Thank you so much, Jennifer! We're thrilled that your rescue dog found their forever home. Your dedication to giving a second chance means everything to us. Please keep us updated!

testimonials.name: Michael R.
testimonials.text: Good experience overall, but the application process took longer than expected. The staff was friendly when I finally got answers. My adopted cat is amazing though, so it was worth the wait. Just wish the communication had been faster.

reply.name: David Park
reply.text: Michael, we appreciate your feedback. We're working to streamline our application process. Your adopted cat is lucky to have found such a caring home. Thank you for choosing PetCenter!

testimonials.name: Amanda K.
testimonials.text: Very satisfied with my adoption experience. The staff was professional and genuinely cared about finding the right match. My rabbit has been such a joy. Only small note: the adoption fee could have been explained more upfront.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Amanda, thank you for the feedback! We're so happy you and your rabbit are bonding. We'll improve our upfront fee communication. Enjoy many happy years together!

testimonials.name: Robert T.
testimonials.text: Difficult experience with the adoption process. Multiple follow-ups were needed to get information. The pet we adopted is wonderful, but getting to that point was frustrating. Communication needs serious improvement.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Robert, we sincerely apologize for the communication gaps. Your feedback helps us improve. Your adopted pet is lucky to have a caring home. We'd welcome a chance to make things right.

testimonials.name: Elena V.
testimonials.text: Exceeded all expectations! From initial inquiry to bringing my new bird home, every step was handled professionally and with genuine care. The staff answered every question thoroughly. My bird is healthy and happy. Couldn't be more grateful!

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Elena, your kind words truly mean the world to us! We're honored to have helped you find your feathered friend. We'd love to hear updates on your bird's journey!

testimonials.name: Christopher L.
testimonials.text: Worst adoption experience ever. The process was confusing, staff was dismissive of my questions, and I wasn't properly informed about the pet's needs. I only give one star because the pet itself is fine, but I would never return and don't recommend this to others.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Christopher, we're genuinely sorry for this experience. This does not reflect our values. We'd like to understand what went wrong and make it right. Please contact us directly to discuss.

testimonials.name: Lisa H.
testimonials.text: Great experience overall. The adoption process was clear and the staff was supportive. The only minor issue was that the health records could have been more detailed, but the pet is healthy and doing great!

reply.name: David Park
reply.text: Lisa, thank you for adopting and for the feedback! We'll ensure health records are more comprehensive going forward. Your adopted pet found the perfect home!

testimonials.name: Marcus W.
testimonials.text: Mixed feelings about this adoption. The pet is great, but the application approval took longer than stated. Communication was inconsistent - some replies were quick, others took days. I hope they improve their response times, as pets need reliable support.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Marcus, thank you for the honest feedback. We're implementing faster approval processes. Your adopted pet is lucky to have such a thoughtful owner. Please reach out anytime!

testimonials.name: Priya S.
testimonials.text: From the first phone call to bringing our kitten home, everything was handled with so much care. The staff clearly love what they do, and it showed in every interaction. Our kitten is thriving and we couldn't be happier with how smooth the whole adoption was.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Priya, this made our day to read! We're so glad your kitten has settled in so well. Thank you for trusting us with such an important decision.

testimonials.name: Daniel K.
testimonials.text: Best adoption experience we've had. The team took the time to match us with a dog that actually fits our lifestyle instead of just approving anyone. Our new dog is healthy, well-adjusted, and clearly came from a place that took good care of him.

reply.name: David Park
reply.text: Daniel, thank you for taking the time to find the right match rather than rushing it. That's exactly the approach we aim for. Wishing you and your dog many happy years together!

testimonials.name: Rachel T.
testimonials.text: Really solid experience overall. Staff were friendly and answered all our questions. The paperwork took a bit longer than we expected, but everyone was polite about it and our new cat is doing wonderfully. Would recommend to anyone considering adoption.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Rachel, thank you for your patience with the paperwork and for the kind words! We're always looking at ways to speed up processing without cutting corners. So glad your cat is settling in well.

testimonials.name: Omar F.
testimonials.text: Good experience adopting our rabbit. Staff clearly knew their animals well and gave us solid care advice. Only minor complaint is the facility could use better signage, we got a little lost on our first visit. Everything else was great and our rabbit is happy and healthy.

reply.name: David Park
reply.text: Omar, thanks for flagging the signage, that's genuinely useful feedback and we'll look into improving it. Glad the rest of the visit went smoothly and that your rabbit is doing great!

testimonials.name: Nicole B.
testimonials.text: Mixed experience. The adoption itself went fine and our dog is great, but we had to call multiple times to get updates on the status of our application. Once we got through, staff were helpful, it was just hard to reach anyone at first. Communication could use work.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Nicole, we're sorry it was difficult to reach us at first, that's not the experience we want. We're working on improving our response times. Really glad your dog has found a good home with you.

testimonials.name: Tyler M.
testimonials.text: The pet we adopted is fantastic and clearly well cared for before we got her. That said, the adoption process felt disorganized, we were told conflicting information by two different staff members about required documents. Not a dealbreaker, but worth improving.

reply.name: David Park
reply.text: Tyler, thank you for pointing this out, conflicting information shouldn't happen and we'll review our documentation process with the team. Glad she's settling in well with you.

testimonials.name: Brittany C.
testimonials.text: Frustrating process from start to finish. Took nearly three weeks to get approved with very little communication in between, and I had to follow up every time myself. The pet is genuinely sweet and healthy, which is the only reason this isn't one star. Support needs to be more proactive.

reply.name: Sarah Chen
reply.text: Brittany, three weeks with minimal updates is well below what we aim for and we're sorry for the frustration this caused. We're actively working on more proactive status updates. Thank you for sticking with the process, and we're glad your pet is doing well.

testimonials.name: Kevin D.
testimonials.text: Very disappointing experience. Staff seemed overwhelmed and disorganized, our application was lost once and we had to resubmit everything. Took over a month total. The dog we ended up adopting is wonderful, but I can't recommend the process itself to anyone considering adopting here.

reply.name: David Park
reply.text: Kevin, losing your application is unacceptable and not up to our standard, we're sincerely sorry. We've since tightened our intake tracking process to prevent this from happening again. We'd welcome the chance to make this right, please reach out directly.
